title: Synapse size balance had no clear link to movie response similarity in 1,441 Allen V1 connections
abstract: We tested whether balanced synapse sizes relate to similar visual responses in one Allen V1 Deep Dive mouse. We joined individual contact sizes to a published matched activity table. The sample had 1,441 connections, including 177 with multiple contacts. With contact count, mean size, geometry and both cell roles controlled, a 0.1 balance increase gave a 0.00505 change in movie response correlation. The nominal 95% dyadic interval was -0.01095 to 0.02105. Three alternative activity measures also had intervals that included zero. The repeated-only graph had just seven independent endpoint contrasts. Additional controls left 0.055% of its balance variation. Thus, the data do not resolve a size-balance relation. A larger anatomical panel repeated an earlier conditional size-allocation result. One mouse, selected connections, summary activity measures and uncertain size-to-strength mapping limit the study. Code, contact records, source hashes, independent checks and figures are supplied.
